"""Fetch only the approved generic COCO initializer, never a game OCR model."""
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request,json,hashlib
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
URL='https://github.com/ultralytics/assets/releases/download/v8.3.0/yolo11n.pt'
target=ROOT/'official/yolo11n.pt';target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
if target.exists():raise RuntimeError('Existing weights preserved; verify source instead of downloading twice')
limit=20*1024*1024;size=0
with urllib.request.urlopen(URL,timeout=60) as response:
    announced=int(response.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))
    if announced>limit:raise RuntimeError('Unexpected size; no oversized download')
    with target.open('xb') as stream:
        while block:=response.read(128*1024):
            size+=len(block)
            if size>limit:raise RuntimeError('Stopped at small-download cap; preserve partial file')
            stream.write(block)
report={'source':URL,'purpose':'Official generic COCO detector initialization, approved by user. Not community game-coordinate weights.',
    'bytes':size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'path':str(target)}
(ROOT/'official-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(report)

"""Own captured frames + own checked transcripts. No third-party OCR weights,
predictions, character boxes or parser enter this dataset.
Two visually inspected anchor layouts seed same-position HUD character boxes.
All annotations are assistant-reviewed research labels, not human gold.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,math
import cv2,numpy as np,yaml
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;FT=ROOT.parent/'coordinate-finetune-20261015';V3=FT/'paired-v3'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
CLASSES=list('0123456789-,+:')
def main():
    output=ROOT/'pilot-v2';output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if (output/'pilot-manifest.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('Preserve pilot annotations')
    dataset=output/'pilot-data';(dataset/'images').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);(dataset/'labels').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    contexts=read(FT/'context-v4/context-manifest.json')['clockLabels'];assert len(contexts)==27
    labels={int(r['id'][-6:]):r for r in contexts};anchors={}
    for frame in [744,884]:
        prefix=labels[frame]['id']+'@readout-line';im=cv2.imread(str(V3/'native-preprocessed'/f'{prefix}.tophat.png'),0)
        text=labels[frame]['text'].replace(' ','');mask=(im[4:40]>200).sum(0)>2
        runs=[(int(a),int(b)) for a,b in np.flatnonzero(np.diff(np.r_[False,mask,False])).reshape(-1,2) if 30<=a and b<790]
        assert len(runs)==len(text)==32
        boxes=[]
        for index,((a,b),char) in enumerate(zip(runs,text)):
            # Stable font cells: a narrow '1' must leave room for other digits
            # when timestamp seconds change, rather than clipping their stroke.
            if char.isdigit():
                if char=='1':a-=5;b+=4
                elif char=='7':a-=6;b+=5
                else:a-=2;b+=2
                top,bottom=3,39
            elif char=='+':
                # Visual QA found TopHat erased part of the horizontal arm in
                # anchor884. Full square uses the raw-image-visible glyph.
                if frame==884:a,b=733,763
                else:a,b=726,754
                top,bottom=10,38
            else:
                ys=np.where(im[4:40,max(0,a):b]>200)[0];assert len(ys)
                top=max(2,int(ys.min())+4-2);bottom=min(46,int(ys.max())+4+3)
                a-=2;b+=2
            boxes.append([a,top,b,bottom])
        anchors[frame]={'sourceImage':str(V3/'native-preprocessed'/f'{prefix}.tophat.png'),'sourceSHA256':sha(V3/'native-preprocessed'/f'{prefix}.tophat.png'),'transcript':text,'boxes':boxes,
            'review':'All 32 horizontal anchor proposals viewed over original-color image before use. Fixed font cells expanded for narrow 1; propagated only within the same known stationary group.'}
    rows=[]
    for frame,r in labels.items():
        anchor=744 if frame<800 else 884
        assert frame in (range(744,754) if anchor==744 else range(884,901))
        image=V3/'native-preprocessed'/f"{r['id']}@readout-line.raw.png"
        raw=cv2.imread(str(image));assert raw.shape==(48,892,3)
        text=r['text'].replace(' ','');assert len(text)==32
        target=dataset/'images'/f'{frame:06d}.png';assert cv2.imwrite(str(target),raw)
        objects=[];lines=[]
        for char,box in zip(text,anchors[anchor]['boxes']):
            a,t,b,d=box;assert 0<=a<b<=892 and 0<=t<d<=48
            cls=CLASSES.index(char);objects.append({'class':cls,'char':char,'xyxy':box})
            lines.append(f'{cls} {(a+b)/2/892:.8f} {(t+d)/2/48:.8f} {(b-a)/892:.8f} {(d-t)/48:.8f}')
        (dataset/'labels'/f'{frame:06d}.txt').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
        rows.append({'id':r['id'],'frame':frame,'kind':'annotated-text','image':str(target),'imageSHA256':sha(target),'sourceImage':r['sourceImage'],'sourceSHA256':r['sourceSHA256'],'rawPreprocessedSource':str(image),'rawPreprocessedSHA256':sha(image),'anchor':anchor,'text':r['text'],'objects':objects})
        if frame in [744,747,750,753,884,887,890,893,896]:
            source=cv2.imread(r['sourceImage']);negative=source[:33,32:640]
            negative=cv2.resize(negative,(884,48),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
            negative=cv2.copyMakeBorder(negative,0,0,4,4,cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,value=(0,0,0))
            negpath=dataset/'images'/f'{frame:06d}-background.png';assert cv2.imwrite(str(negpath),negative)
            (dataset/'labels'/f'{frame:06d}-background.txt').write_text('')
            rows.append({'id':r['id']+'-background','frame':frame,'kind':'background-negative','image':str(negpath),'imageSHA256':sha(negpath),'sourceImage':r['sourceImage'],'sourceSHA256':r['sourceSHA256'],'sourceRect':[32,0,608,33],'objects':[]})
    imagelist=''.join(row['image'].replace('\\','/')+'\n' for row in rows)
    (dataset/'train.txt').write_text(imagelist)
    config={'path':str(dataset).replace('\\','/'),'train':'train.txt','val':'train.txt','names':{i:c for i,c in enumerate(CLASSES)}}
    (output/'pilot-data.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(config,sort_keys=False))
    manifest={'purpose':'Small fit-only gate for own YOLO training, before broad data annotation. Validation list equals training list, explicitly NOT held-out accuracy. Use last epoch, not best-fit selection.',
        'humanVerified':False,'classes':CLASSES,'anchors':anchors,'rows':rows,'textFrames':27,'backgroundFrames':9,'objects':sum(len(r['objects']) for r in rows),
        'sourceClockManifestSHA256':sha(FT/'context-v4/context-manifest.json'),'thirdPartyGameWeightsOrPseudoLabelsUsed':False,
        'heldoutGroup776to787Excluded':True,'newCoordinatesOrClockValuesInvented':False,'limitations':['Two stationary positions only; this pilot cannot establish broad character or background generalization.','Transferred font-cell boxes are approximate; inspect QA before training.','Nine background negatives are upper-band crops from the training source frames, not independent UI negatives.']}
    manifest['annotationRevision']='v2 before training: raw-image visual QA expands 7 top strokes and + horizontal arm; initial draft kept separately in parent.'
    (output/'pilot-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    # All training text/negative inputs visible for annotation QA. Boxes use
    # class names, never model predictions. No third-party annotator involved.
    for page in range(math.ceil(len(rows)/9)):
        group=rows[page*9:(page+1)*9];canvas=np.full((len(group)*98,1784,3),235,np.uint8)
        for index,row in enumerate(group):
            image=cv2.resize(cv2.imread(row['image']),(1784,96))
            for obj in row['objects']:
                a,t,b,d=obj['xyxy'];cv2.rectangle(image,(2*a,2*t),(2*b,2*d),(0,255,0),1)
                cv2.putText(image,obj['char'],(2*a,12),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,.3,(0,255,255),1)
            canvas[index*98:index*98+96]=image
        cv2.imwrite(str(output/f'pilot-qa-{page+1}.png'),canvas)
    print('Own pilot:',len(rows),'images,',manifest['objects'],'character boxes, fit validation only')
if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Small own-label fit gate. Uses official generic COCO initialization only."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,json,hashlib,time,argparse
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.environ['YOLO_CONFIG_DIR']=str(ROOT/'settings')
os.environ['YOLO_AUTOINSTALL']='false'
os.environ['CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG']=':4096:8'
import torch,ultralytics
from ultralytics import YOLO,settings
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--epochs',type=int,default=40);options=parser.parse_args()
    epochs=options.epochs
    if epochs not in [40,200]:raise ValueError('Only declared fit-budget trials are allowed')
    settings.update({k:False for k in ['sync','hub','wandb','mlflow','comet','tensorboard','clearml','neptune','dvc'] if k in settings})
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    data=ROOT/'pilot-v2';manifest=json.loads((data/'pilot-manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert len(manifest['rows'])==36 and manifest['objects']==864
    assert not manifest['thirdPartyGameWeightsOrPseudoLabelsUsed']
    assert not any(776<=r['frame']<=787 for r in manifest['rows'])
    for row in manifest['rows']:assert sha(Path(row['image']))==row['imageSHA256']
    initializer=ROOT/'official/yolo11n.pt';provenance=json.loads((ROOT/'official-provenance.json').read_text())
    assert sha(initializer)==provenance['sha256']
    model=YOLO(str(initializer));assert len(model.names)==80
    out=ROOT/f'training/pilot-v2-{epochs}e'
    if out.exists():raise RuntimeError('Preserve previous run')
    args=dict(data=str(data/'pilot-data.yaml'),project=str(ROOT/'training'),name=f'pilot-v2-{epochs}e',exist_ok=False,
        epochs=epochs,patience=0,imgsz=896,rect=True,batch=8,device=0,workers=0,cache=False,
        optimizer='AdamW',lr0=.001,lrf=.01,weight_decay=.0005,warmup_epochs=3.,seed=20261015,deterministic=True,
        amp=False,plots=False,save=True,save_period=-1,val=True,
        hsv_h=0.,hsv_s=0.,hsv_v=0.,degrees=0.,translate=0.,scale=0.,shear=0.,perspective=0.,
        flipud=0.,fliplr=0.,mosaic=0.,mixup=0.,copy_paste=0.,close_mosaic=0)
    started=time.time();model.train(**args)
    own=out/'weights/last.pt';assert own.is_file()
    result={'purpose':'Fit-only pilot. Train and framework val are same 36 images, never a held-out accuracy claim. Fixed last epoch used.',
        'ownSpecializedWeights':str(own),'weightsSHA256':sha(own),'initializer':provenance,'datasetManifestSHA256':sha(data/'pilot-manifest.json'),
        'torch':torch.__version__,'torchCUDA':torch.version.cuda,'ultralytics':ultralytics.__version__,'GPU':torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),'seconds':time.time()-started,
        'args':args,'thirdPartyGameWeightsOrPseudoLabelsUsed':False,'productionChanged':False}
    report=ROOT/('pilot-training.json' if epochs==40 else f'pilot-training-{epochs}e.json')
    report.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('Saved own specialized pilot weights',own,flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Own specialized model and own decoder, label-blind inference on fixed PNGs.
Truth is never loaded by this script. Community outputs are not used.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import os,json,sys,time,hashlib
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.environ['YOLO_CONFIG_DIR']=str(ROOT/'settings');os.environ['YOLO_AUTOINSTALL']='false'
import torch,cv2,ultralytics
from ultralytics import YOLO
from coordinate_decode import decode
CLASSES=list('0123456789-,+:')
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def main():
    epochs=int(sys.argv[1]);assert epochs in [40,200]
    weights=ROOT/f'training/pilot-v2-{epochs}e/weights/last.pt';out=ROOT/f'evaluation-{epochs}e.json'
    if out.exists():raise RuntimeError('Preserve previous inference report')
    items=json.loads((ROOT.parent/'coordinate-finetune-20261015/paired-v3/replay-inputs.json').read_text())['inputs']
    torch.set_num_threads(4);model=YOLO(str(weights));assert list(model.names.values())==CLASSES
    rows=[]
    for item in items:
        path=ROOT.parent/'coordinate-gap-study-20261015/native-preprocessed'/f"{item['id']}.raw.png"
        image=cv2.imread(str(path));assert image.shape==(48,892,3)
        started=time.perf_counter()
        prediction=model.predict(source=image,imgsz=896,rect=True,conf=.25,iou=.45,max_det=256,device='cpu',verbose=False,save=False)[0]
        boxes=prediction.boxes.cpu();objects=[{'char':CLASSES[int(c)],'class':int(c),'score':float(s),'xyxy':list(map(float,b))} for b,s,c in zip(boxes.xyxy.tolist(),boxes.conf.tolist(),boxes.cls.tolist())]
        result=decode(objects)
        rows.append({'id':item['id'],'sourceId':item['sourceId'],'image':str(path),'imageSHA256':sha(path),'detections':objects,'decode':result,'milliseconds':(time.perf_counter()-started)*1000})
    report={'scope':'Own pilot detector; fixed same-session source frames, label-blind CPU inference; no position prior. Includes trained-fit sources, scored separately.',
        'epochs':epochs,'weights':str(weights),'weightsSHA256':sha(weights),'classes':CLASSES,'torch':torch.__version__,'ultralytics':ultralytics.__version__,
        'decoderSHA256':sha(ROOT/'coordinate_decode.py'),'detectorConf':.25,'detectorIoU':.45,'results':rows}
    out.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print('Own-model replay completed',epochs,len(rows),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
